verdict.rationale: Devin documents a full public API (devin-docs-7) with capabilities like creating sessions on behalf of users (devin-docs-8), enabling integration into external applications/workflows, plus a CLI and MCP server for programmatic control (devin-docs-4, devin-docs-6). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s at standard paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API usage.
